title: Visual judge finding
description: One issue the judge found in a built map. reasoning comes first so the verdict follows from it.

type.description: What kind of issue this is.

severity.description: blocker: the map is unusable or broken. major: clearly against the intent or preset. minor: polish; never sent back to the builder.

imageId.description: The capture_zones image the finding rests on, as `<zone>:<view>`, such as `kitchen:a`; the cutaway is `<mapId>:top`.

visible.description: What the image shows, in the judge's words.

specField.description: The build_map spec field to change, such as rooms[1].wallHeight, when the judge can tell.

reasoning.description: Why the image counts as a defect against the intent line or preset rubric, written before the verdict.

verdict.description: The one-sentence conclusion the reasoning supports.
